_comment: Tuning knobs for the Content Board Curator workflow, loaded at run time via DownloadTemplate (template_name: datasets/board_intake.json), so edits here take effect on the next run without touching the workflow. parse_board_config defaults every key, so a partial or broken file degrades, it does not fail the run.
_comment_source: The board is the open issues labelled `post` on a repository - the ideas a human parks there. This is a read-only intake: the curator never comments on, labels or closes an issue. An issue is re-imported only if article_queue does not already carry its ENTRY_ID (gh-<number>) or its LINK, so keeping an issue open is safe.
label: post
_comment_defaults: What an imported row carries besides the issue's own title, body and link. CATEGORIES must name one of agents/n8n/datasets/blog_categories.json or the article lane refuses the row before it drafts; ASSET_TYPES is the article lane's default pair (the wide raster hero plus the wide diagram; the blog is read on a screen, so the 4:5 pair is never requested); AUDIENCE is the reader level, one of NONE, LOW, MEDIUM or ADVANCED from prompts/article_audiences.md (blank reads as NONE); MAX_WORDS and PRIORITY are the same defaults a hand-authored row starts from. Every one of them is a field on the appended article_queue row, so a human can change it per row after import.
